blocks.title: How a check passes
blocks.text: Each proposed call, approval attempt and sweep context has an expected decision (and, where it matters, the rule that must produce it) in `scenario.toml`. A check passes when the recorded decision and rule match, and the gateway enforced the decision: an allowed call ran, a denied call never reached the tool, an approval-gated call waited. Tests pass when `unittest` says so, in four layers: L1 policy units, L2 the named invariants, L3 the gateway end to end, L4 the recorded replay.

blocks.title: The incident, call by call
blocks.sub: 10 proposed calls: 7 tool executions, 3 denials, 1 approval request. Production rollback evidence went from 0.62 (denied, below the 0.80 floor) to 0.94; payment-service ended on v4.17.2.

blocks.title: One request, 8 contexts
blocks.sub: The same production rollback of payment-service, re-asked with one thing changed each time: 1 ALLOW, 2 ALLOW_WITH_APPROVAL, 5 DENY. The agent, the tool and the request never change.

blocks.sub: Select a row for what was varied and what was held constant.

blocks.title: Policy is code, so it has tests
blocks.sub: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`, recorded by `python3 -m authz.verify`: 51 test methods, 153 tests and subtests, 153 passed, in 4 layers. The 14 invariants are also recorded by the run itself.

blocks.title: L2 · The named production invariants
blocks.sub: 14 of 14 hold, across 89 named cases. Each case is asserted again by the test suite. Select one for its cases.

blocks.title: L1 · Decision table
blocks.sub: Each case names the request, the expected decision and the rule that must produce it.

blocks.title: L3 · Gateway integration
blocks.sub: The real enforcement path: denied calls never reach a tool, constraints are applied by the gateway, approvals wait, stale authority is re-checked, tools refuse calls without a broker credential, and a failing policy engine means DENY.

blocks.title: L4 · Recorded replay
blocks.sub: The incident re-run into a fresh directory and compared byte for byte with the recorded run; every published fact re-derived from the artifacts.

blocks.title: The hash-chained decision log
blocks.sub: 23 records in `decisions.jsonl`, each re-hashed from the file by `authz.verify`. Chain valid: true. Editing one DENY to ALLOW in a copy was detected: true.

blocks.title: Every record
blocks.sub: Each record carries the previous record's hash. Tamper-evident, not tamper-proof: in production, anchor the chain in an independent, append-only store.

blocks.title: From the scenario to this page
blocks.sub: The files that carry each check, in order. Every row's Source tab names its own entries.
